  <h2 class="info-card__heading">Training content</h2>
</div>

:::{.card-copy}
This training introduces R, a **free and widely used programming language
for data analysis and statistics**. It is designed for researchers who
work with data, but have little or no programming experience.

Through short demonstrations and hands-on exercises, you learn how to
read data into R, clean and reshape it, summarise it, and create
publication-quality plots. You work with real research data throughout,
and leave with code you can reuse for your own projects.
:::
:::

:::{.info-card .info-card--learning-outcomes}
<div class="info-card__header">
  <span class="info-card__icon" aria-hidden="true">
    <img src="img/icons/target.svg" alt="" class="info-card__icon-img">
  </span>
  <h2 class="info-card__heading">Learning outcomes</h2>
</div>

:::{.card-copy}
1. Use RStudio to write and run R code, and organise your work in projects
2. Read data from spreadsheet and text files into R
3. Clean, filter and reshape data with the tidyverse
4. Summarise data with descriptive statistics
5. Create and customise plots with ggplot2
:::
:::
